english.note: Use 問題 as the all-purpose word for an ordinary question, a topic or issue, or a matter whose validity is at issue.
This is the all-purpose choice for a question or inquiry.
Use this as the all-purpose word for a question that someone puts forward.

examples.english: I have a question to ask you.
